import sys, json, os, random, subprocess, copy
from fractions import Fraction
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submit')
from t_common import *
from t_naive import naive_image
import scamp_pipeline as sp
from t_fuzz import mutate, byte_mut, base_compile, base_lookup, rng

def fib_of(img):
    fib=[]
    for i,st in enumerate(img['stages']):
        for nd in st['nodes']:
            for r in nd['rules']:
                pr = sp.parse_prefix(r['prefix'])
                assert pr is not None, r
                assert sp.canon_prefix(*pr) == r['prefix'], r
                fib.append((pr[0],pr[1],r['hop']))
    return fib

def check_image(img):
    """Independent full validation; returns fib or raises."""
    assert set(img.keys()) == {'status','capacities','max_stride','cuts','stages','used_bits','peak'}, img.keys()
    assert img['status']=='ok'
    caps=img['capacities']; ms=img['max_stride']; cuts=img['cuts']
    S=len(caps)
    assert 4<=S<=16 and len(cuts)==S+1 and len(img['stages'])==S and len(img['used_bits'])==S
    assert cuts[0]==0 and cuts[-1]==128
    for i in range(S): assert 1<=cuts[i+1]-cuts[i]<=ms
    fib=fib_of(img)
    assert len(fib)<=2048
    exp=naive_image(fib,caps,ms,cuts)
    assert exp==img, ('image mismatch', json.dumps(exp)[:900], json.dumps(img)[:900])
    assert all(u<=c for u,c in zip(img['used_bits'],caps))
    assert Fraction(img['peak']['num'],img['peak']['den']) == max(Fraction(u,c) for u,c in zip(img['used_bits'],caps))
    return fib

lines=[]; reqs=[]
for t in range(500):
    base = base_compile if rng.random()<0.5 else base_lookup
    m = mutate(base)
    s = json.dumps(m, separators=(',',':'), allow_nan=False)
    if rng.random()<0.2: s = byte_mut(s.encode()).decode('utf-8','replace')
    s = s.replace('\n',' ')
    lines.append(s); reqs.append(m)
inp = ''.join(l+'\n' for l in lines)
p = subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=inp.encode('utf-8','replace'), capture_output=True, timeout=900)
assert p.returncode==0, p.stderr[:2000]
out = p.stdout.split(b'\n'); assert out[-1]==b''; out=out[:-1]
assert len(out)==len(lines)
nok=nlook=0
for i,o in enumerate(out):
    r = json.loads(o)
    if r.get('status')!='ok': continue
    if 'answers' in r:
        nlook+=1
        img = reqs[i].get('image') if isinstance(reqs[i],dict) else None
        addrs = reqs[i].get('addresses')
        assert isinstance(img,dict) and isinstance(addrs,list), (i, reqs[i])
        fib = check_image(img)
        assert len(r['answers'])==len(addrs)
        for s,a in zip(addrs, r['answers']):
            av = sp.parse_ipv6(s)
            assert av is not None, (s,)
            best=None
            for (pa,pl,ph) in fib:
                if (av & sp.TMASK[pl])==pa and (best is None or pl>best[1]): best=(ph,pl)
            exp = {'hop':None,'prefix_length':None} if best is None else {'hop':best[0],'prefix_length':best[1]}
            assert a==exp, (s,a,exp)
    else:
        nok+=1
        fib = check_image(r)
print('ok compiles verified', nok, 'ok lookups verified', nlook)
print('FUZZ2 OK')
EOF
